lead.headline: Nothing to set: Friday's reports confirmed the lineup
lead.deck: Wilson OUT, Wentz throws to Jefferson Monday; every Sunday starter undesignated and Kamara cleared.
lead.body: The bad news first. Garrett Wilson is out at Kansas City with the concussion, confirmed on the Jets' Friday list, and Justin Jefferson catches passes from Carson Wentz on Monday: Kevin O'Connell called Kyler Murray's hamstring strain week-to-week on Thursday, before ESPN set its 18.3, so the number already knows. Friday's reports were otherwise quiet for AVIATO. Allen, Gordon, Diggs, Likely and Allgeier drew no designation; Washington ruled out Burks and Dyami Brown, leaving Diggs the clear first read for Jayden Daniels; Philadelphia listed DeVonta Smith out for Joe Milton III's first start, the Giants D/ST's opening. Alvin Kamara practised fully and came off the report, but stays 2.0 behind Allgeier for the FLEX. AVIATO lead 8.9 to 5.58 and ESPN calls it 49-51; there is nothing to set.
